AUTHORED ANNOTATOR NOTES — not a real coach recording. Real UVG-VCM source has no audio.
[source 1.50–2.70s] Only two anonymous net players are illustrated; other players and the remainder of the 10-second rally are not reconstructed.
[source 1.80s] Near right-side jumper has a cocked arm; approximate visible shoulder/elbow/wrist points guide a conditional vertical-plane pose.
[source about 2.02s ±0.05s] Overhead attack hand/ball overlap.
[source about 2.08s ±0.05s] Possible opposite blocker contact; overlap/occlusion requires coach confirmation.
[source 2.17s] Follow-through arm points guide the next key. Court positions, heights, body depth and jump lift are illustrative assumptions. Correct them and review before exporting.
